description:
Read one conversation: contact/assignment/tag details plus its message history.

Messages are returned newest first. To page further back, call again with
`before_time` set to the oldest returned message's timestamp.

before_time.description: Only messages strictly older than this POSIX timestamp — use for paging back through history.

channel_id.description: The 360dialog channel ID of the inbox to operate on.

conversation_id.description: The conversation's contact WhatsApp ID (phone-style like '4915112345678', or business-scoped). Take it from list_conversations or search_conversations results; do not guess it.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

since_time.description: Only messages at or after this POSIX timestamp.

name: getchat_get_conversation
title: Get conversation
